title: Feature holds on LAKE: close every surface entry, raise every feature entry to 200, release all holds, run 20,000 ticks; do feature-referenced units ever arrive

predictions.model: F5 A · feature entries can produce arrivals
predictions.expects: arm feature_only: new units whose six-tuple carries feature_idx >= 0
arm feature_only: nothing on the surface or water in 20,000 ticks; arm control: surface waves as usual

kill_criterion: a feature-referenced arrival in any replicate kills B; the control arm must show surface waves or the fort is not comparable
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save
a fort with zero feature entries (OCEAN) tests F14 by its control arm only

arms.name: feature_only
pre: local site=df.world_site.find(df.global.plotinfo.site_id); local x0,x1=math.floor(site.global_min_x/16),math.floor(site.global_max_x/16); local y0,y1=math.floor(site.global_min_y/16),math.floor(site.global_max_y/16); local f,s=0,0; for _,p in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local r=p.population; if p.type==df.world_population_type.Animal and r.region_x>=x0-1 and r.region_x<=x1 and r.region_y>=y0-1 and r.region_y<=y1 and p.quantity_max<10000000 then if r.feature_idx>=0 then p.quantity=200; p.flags.extinct=false; f=f+1 elseif r.cave_id<0 then p.quantity=0; p.flags.extinct=true; s=s+1 end end end; print(('feature entries raised: %d, surface closed: %d'):format(f,s))
